meta.title: RFQ: revoke is not possible after the event closed

plan.title: SRC-RVK-003 — Revoke unavailable after RFQ closure

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ while retaining the buyer session.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier-portal session without leaving the buyer session.
Open the closed RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Verify that no Revoke action is offered after bidding has ended.
Verify that Vendor A's submitted bid remains in the vendor portal.
